title: Towards High-Performance Multimodal Discovery: Evaluating Retrieval Efficacy and Operational Scalability in Digital Libraries
abstract: arXiv:2611.17726v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large-scale digital repositories with million plus digitized volumes serve as vital engines for scientific and scholarly discovery. However, as collections grow, finding specific research or educational material remains a significant challenge. This difficulty is compounded by the multimodal nature of texts, that is, texts which combine dense narrative content with essential illustrative charts, annotated diagrams, and complex layouts. Historically, discovery has been supported by full-text search indexes implemented as inverted indexes (e.g., Lucene or Solr). While these systems scale well for textual strings, they are fundamentally "blind" to the semantic nuance of visual information. translated_title: 迈向高性能多模态发现：评估数字图书馆中的检索效能与运行可扩展性
translated_abstract: 拥有数百万册数字化藏书的大型数字存储库是科学与学术发现的重要引擎。然而，随着馆藏规模的不断增长，查找特定的研究或教育材料仍然是一项重大挑战。文本的多模态特性进一步加剧了这一困难，即这些文本将密集的叙述内容与重要的说明性图表、注释示意图以及复杂的版面布局结合在一起。从历史上看，文献发现一直由以倒排索引（如 Lucene 或 Solr）实现的全文本搜索索引提供支持。虽然这些系统在处理文本字符串方面具有良好的可扩展性，但它们对视觉信息的语义细微差别在根本上是“视而不见”的。我们探索了通过将文本转换为数值向量来提升发现能力的好处。通过将页面图像表示为数值向量而非 OCR 提取的文本，并对页面上的文本和图像同时进行这种向量化处理，我们能够同时捕获文本和（视觉）……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出将数字图书馆页面（同时涵盖文本与图像）转换为数值向量以克服传统倒排索引对视觉语义的“盲区”，并系统评估了这种多模态检索方法的检索效能与运行可扩展性。
en_tdlr: This paper explores converting digital library pages—capturing both textual and visual content—into numerical vectors to overcome the semantic blindness of traditional inverted indexes, and evaluates the retrieval efficacy and operational scalability of this multimodal discovery approach.
